1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: A birth that cannot complete is where the write's fail decision meets the abandon mechanism; the gate keeps the rule sound over both without testing the refusal itself. The report failures — the crossing reports no usable id, or a malformed one — are hard to force, since the crossing always reports an id, so they stay covered by the rule's text and this gate rather than by a behavioural case. Its five edges span two cells — two prose parents (natural→natural) and three artifact parents (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
